'''{{langr|de|H. Martin R. Wilkening}}''' (born April 28, 1977 in {{langrlink|de|Auetal}}, Germany<ref name="PhD thesis">
{{cite thesis
| last        = {{langr|de|Wilkening}}
| first       = {{langr|de|Martin}}
| year        = 2014
| orig-date   = 2011-06-06
| title       = {{lang|de|Zur Ionendynamik in kristallinen und amorphen Festkörpern : vom Elementarschritt zum makroskopischen Transport}}
| doi         = 10.15488/8388
| doi-access  = free
| language    = de
| degree      = PhD
| location    = Hannover
| publisher   = {{langrlink|de|Gottfried Wilhelm Leibniz Universität Hannover}}
}}</ref>) is a German physical chemist. He is a professor at the [[Graz University of Technology]] and heads the Institute of Chemistry and Technology of Materials (ICTM).

== Career ==
{{langr|de|Wilkening}} studied chemistry at the [[Leibniz University Hannover]] where he also earned his doctorate. His habilitation focused on ultraslow ion transport in solids.

Since 2011, he has been a professor of solid-state chemistry of modern energy storage systems at the [[Graz University of Technology]]. From 2012 to 2019, he also led the CD-Lab "Lithium Batteries: Aging Effects, Technology and New Materials".<ref name="CDLab">{{Cite web |url=https://www.cdg.ac.at/forschungseinheiten/labor/lithium-batterien-alterungseffekte-technologie-und-neue-materialien |title=CD-Lab "Lithium Batteries: Aging Effects, Technology and New Materials" |publisher=Christian Doppler Laboratory for Battery Research |access-date=2025-11-29}}</ref> In 2016, he became the head of the Institute of Chemistry and Technology of Materials (ICTM) at TU Graz.<ref name="ICTM">{{Cite web |url=https://www.tugraz.at/institute/ictm/home |title=Institute of Chemistry and Technology of Materials |publisher=TU Graz |access-date=2025-11-29}}</ref>

== Research ==
{{langr|de|Wilkening}}'s research focuses on ionic diffusion in crystalline and amorphous solids. His group uses techniques such as temperature-dependent [[nuclear magnetic resonance]] (NMR) relaxation measurements and broadband conductivity spectroscopy to study ionic transport processes.<ref name="WG">{{Cite web |url=https://www.tugraz.at/institute/ictm/research/wilkening-group |title=Wilkening Group (TU Graz) |publisher=TU Graz |access-date=2025-11-29}}</ref>

He is the author or co-author of over 200 scientific publications.<ref name="GS">{{Cite web |url=https://scholar.google.at/citations?user=mnUODgwAAAAJ&hl=en |title=Google Scholar: H. Martin R. Wilkening |access-date=2025-11-29}}</ref>

== Awards ==
In 2006, {{langr|de|Wilkening}} received the Starck Prize from the GDCh Division of Solid-State Chemistry and Materials Science.<ref name="Starck">{{Cite web |url=https://www.gdch.de/netzwerk-strukturen/fachstrukturen/festkoerperchemie-materialforschung/preise-ehrungen/promotionspreis.html |title=Starck Prize, GDCh Division of Solid-State Chemistry and Materials Science |publisher=GDCh |access-date=2025-11-29}}</ref>

In 2009, he was awarded the ADUC Prize of the GDCh (Association of German University Professors of Chemistry).<ref name="ADUC">{{Cite web |url=https://www.gdch.de/netzwerk-strukturen/fachstrukturen/aduc/preise-ehrungen/aduc-preis.html |title=ADUC Prize |publisher=GDCh |access-date=2025-11-29}}</ref>
